verdict.rationale: Better Auth's first-party twoFactor plugin documents TOTP authenticator-app setup (the default method), email/SMS OTP, backup codes for account recovery, enabling/disabling 2FA, and trusted-device management, so the TOTP and backup-code core is delivered directly. Nothing in the evidence shows making MFA mandatory for all users or step-up re-authentication for sensitive actions. Missing for 10: documented policy to require/enforce MFA for users, step-up enforcement for sensitive operations, independent hands-on corroboration of the 2FA flow.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can require multi-factor authentication with TOTP authenticator apps and backup codes, with step-up enforcement where needed

citations.quote: totp (default) sets up an authenticator app
Generating backup codes for account recovery
Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) adds an extra security step when users log in.
